docs.search.statement: SELECT path, page, title, substr(body, max(1, instr(lower(body), lower(?1)) - 50), 170) AS snippet, instr(lower(body), lower(?1)) > 51 AS clipped, length(body) > max(1, instr(lower(body), lower(?1)) - 50) + 169 AS cut FROM sections WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%' || lower(?1) || '%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%' || lower(?1) || '%' ORDER BY path LIKE 'adr/%', lower(title) LIKE '%' || lower(?1) || '%' DESC, path LIMIT 12
